components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Advances the clearest governed action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #075dcc; color: #fff; font: 600 16px/1.2 "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -16px rgba(9, 105, 232, .8); transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #064da9; box-shadow: 0 12px 26px -16px rgba(9, 105, 232, .9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #075dcc; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #053e88; }

components.name: Outlined Input
components.description: A persistently bounded field for high-attention operational input.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #0f172a; font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-field-input { min-height: 58px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #aeb8c7; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #0f172a; font: 400 16px/1.5 "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms ease-out; } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: #65758b; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { border-color: #075dcc; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(7, 93, 204, .14); outline: none; }

components.name: Commercial Navigation Spine
components.description: The seven daily commercial stages in stable journey order.
components.html: InboxLeadsRFQsQuotesOrdersFulfilmentReceivables
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 240px; font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 10px; color: #0f172a; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(100, 116, 139, .1); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #075dcc; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-active { background: #075dcc; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(7, 93, 204, .3); } .ds-nav-active:hover, .ds-nav-active:active { background: #064da9; }

components.name: Standard Card
components.description: A restrained work surface for one coherent operational group.
components.html:
Lineage

Source evidence and downstream references remain connected.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(100, 116, 139, .16); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #0f172a; font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(100, 116, 139, .28); } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #075dcc; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card-copy { margin: 0; color: #64748b; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Verified Status Chip
components.description: Marks reconciled, posted, or otherwise verified completion.
components.css: .ds-chip-complete { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #20c7b5; border-radius: 8px; background: #20c7b5; color: #08172a; font: 600 14px/1.2 "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-complete svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-chip-complete:hover { background: #1bb09f; }

narrative.overview:
Nexora makes consequential commercial work feel traceable before it feels decorative. Its visual world is assured, precise, and evidence-led: deep navy establishes chain-of-custody context, quiet paper surfaces hold the operator's task, and restrained blue and teal identify action and verified completion. Dense records stay legible through disciplined rules, alignment, and typography rather than ornamental effects.

The system should remain calm under real operational load. Authentication demonstrates the world with an illustrative ledger, but that split composition is a surface expression rather than a universal page template; new screens should reveal evidence, ownership, status, and lineage in the structure that best fits their task.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence-led hierarchy with clear ownership, status, and lineage.
Cambay display type paired with Source Sans 3 operational text.
Navy, white, cobalt, and teal used in stable semantic roles.
Restrained flat surfaces, fine rules, and solid actions.
Compact enterprise density without sacrificing 44px targets or visible focus.

rules.name: The Evidence Before Accent Rule
rules.body: Navy holds evidence, blue advances work, and teal confirms governed completion; never exchange those roles for decoration.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Cambay names and frames the work; Source Sans 3 operates it. Do not use the display face as dense data text.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If hierarchy can be expressed with spacing, tone, or a fine rule, do not add a shadow.

dos: Do show evidence, owner, status, and the next governed action in the same decision context.
Do use Cambay for orientation and Source Sans 3 for operational reading.
Do preserve solid actions, persistent field borders, visible focus, and 44px minimum targets.
Do keep the seven commercial navigation stages in their journey order across roles and breakpoints.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass effects, animated scanner motifs, or generic AI spectacle.
Don't turn every evidence group into a floating card when alignment and fine rules are clearer.
Don't use teal as a general accent or blue as proof of completion.
Don't copy the login page's split composition into unrelated operational screens.
